# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Compact Weight Boundary Repair

> The Awtsmoos keeps the six essential vessels near while distant garments cross a later stream;
> Awtsmoos.com refuses both a pending bootstrap and a parser-blocking six-megabyte dream.

## Isolated Browser Evidence

- Production release `204ab8c714c44d4775ab8a798beaf1c8646a288b` serves the exact tested bundle and all Drive models.
- A fresh isolated headless Chrome profile reported no HTTP errors, no failed requests, no console errors, and no exceptions.
- The main thread remained occupied for more than thirty-eight seconds before `AwtsmoosMitzvahWorld` was published.
- The compact artifact grew from roughly 5.17 MB to 6.29 MB after statically importing `MinimalMeadowFeatureScheduler.js`.
- `MinimalMeadowFeatureScheduler.js` statically imports `MinimalMeadowFeatureBundle.js`, which imports rich world systems and optional hydration roots.

## Root Cause

The essential scheduler boundary was corrected, but the scheduler retained a static edge to the rich feature bundle. CompactJS therefore folded heavy world and hydration code into the parser-blocking entry module. Essential bootstrap became reliable but first execution became unacceptably heavy.

## Authorized Full-File Writes

1. Rewrite `MinimalMeadowFeatureScheduler.js`:
   - keep bootstrap features and readiness receipts statically folded;
   - remove the static `MinimalMeadowFeatureBundle.js` import;
   - resolve that module through `DeferredAppModuleUrl.js`;
   - start rich hydration as an optional promise without awaiting it in essential readiness;
   - preserve injected installers/importers for focused tests.
2. Add a focused scheduler test proving the essential receipt resolves while the rich importer remains pending.
3. Strengthen the real-entry CompactJS proof:
   - require the folded scheduler;
   - reject a folded `installMinimalMeadowFeatures` function;
   - require the source-aware rich bundle URL.
4. Regenerate the entire compact artifact and compare its byte size with the parser-blocking release.
5. Run focused game tests, CompactJS suites, syntax, and an isolated headless production trace.

## Completion Gate

The compact entry must publish playable state promptly with all six systems true. Rich hydration may remain pending or fail without blocking essential readiness. No fatal console exception, relevant HTTP failure, or compact-path 404 may remain.
